sections.overall: This is a year of high visibility and dynamic social interaction, shaped by the Rob Wealth star and the intensity of Fire. You are invited to step into the spotlight and explore the power of collaborative effort over solitary pursuit. This is a year that rewards autonomy, as the annual energy moves independently of your natal anchors. You have the room to experiment with new habits or directions without the heavy pressure of past patterns pulling at your sleeve.

sections.money: This posture leans toward increased spending on social connections or shared ventures. You are free to invest in your network, but the year rewards a mindful approach to boundaries regarding loans or joint expenses.
sections.love: Passionate and rapid developments are supported by the heat of the year. You have the room to experience intense new attractions or to reignite a spark through shared adventures and bold social outings.
sections.health: The year's energy suggests a tendency toward high-intensity activity and restlessness. You are encouraged to balance these peaks of passion with deliberate periods of cooling down and restorative stillness.
sections.rhythm: The flow tends to be steady and neutral, offering a consistent pace rather than sharp peaks or valleys. You may find this a year that suits a rhythmic, sustainable approach to your goals rather than sudden sprints.
sections.advice: You are invited to treat this period as a blank canvas where you can trial a new hobby or a different way of organizing your day. This energy supports stepping outside your usual role, giving you the space to discover who you are when no one is expecting a specific version of you.
